page_title: UDI 0-1 PAR | Udinese v Parma 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+6' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Zion Suzuki has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
90+4' The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
90+2' Parma keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Udinese.
84' A yellow card for a tackle by Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese). Davide Di Marco doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
83' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Udinese.

83' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese)'s poor effort is easily saved by Zion Suzuki. He connects well with a cross, but mistimes it a little, and it heads towards the middle of the target and straight into the grateful hands of the goalkeeper.
81' Kosta Runjaic is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) suffers an injury and Branimir Mlacic comes on.
81' 10:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
78' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
76' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.
76' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) latches on to a lofted pass on the edge of the box and fires the ball towards goal! His strike crashes against the crossbar.
75' Substitution. Sascha Britschgi (Parma) on for Abdoulaye Ndiaye.
75' The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Buksa (Udinese) comes onto the pitch for Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
73' Here is a change. Kingsley Ehizibue is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
73' Juan Arizala (Udinese) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball has crossed the sideline. Parma are taking a throw-in.
72' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nahuel Estevez (Parma).
71' Davide Di Marco shows a yellow card to Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) for a tough tackle.
71' One of the Parma players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.

69' The cross into the penalty area from Juan Arizala (Udinese) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) for Gabriel Strefezza.
66' Substitution. Adrian Bernabe Garcia will be replaced by Christian Ordonez (Parma).
64' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Juan Arizala (Udinese) replaces Hassane Kamara.
64' Substitution. Jakub Piotrowski makes his way off the pitch and Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) comes on as his replacement.
64' The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
63' Udinese win a corner.
61' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
59' Nesta Elphege (Parma) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post.
58' Arthur Atta (Udinese) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
56' The linesman makes the right call and Parma will have a corner.
55' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Maduka Okoye is equal to it and makes an easy save.
54' A player from Udinese commits a rough challenge. Davide Di Marco blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

51' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Nesta Elphege (Parma) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
49' The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
48' It's a throw-in for Udinese.
46' Carlos Cuesta has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Nesta Elphege comes on the pitch for Mateo Pellegrino (Parma).
46' The whistle blows and Davide Di Marco starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+1' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) picks up an injury.
42' The ball is out of play. Parma win a corner kick.
39' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
36' Looks like Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
35' A pass from Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye and the move breaks down.
33' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it goes just over the crossbar.
32' The ball goes out of play and Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
29' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' 58:42 – the latest ball possession ratio.
25' A player from Udinese commits a rough challenge. Davide Di Marco blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
23' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
20' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner which is cleared.
19' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
18' It's a free kick to Parma in a dangerous position. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) jumps into a tackle and Davide Di Marco signals a foul.
16' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Udinese is cautioned for aggressive play.
14' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) takes the corner but it's cleared.
12' Davide Di Marco interrupts the game. One of the players from Udinese won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Free kick. Parma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
10' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
7' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
5' Udinese string together a series of short passes.

3' Alessandro Circati (Parma) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
3' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) will deliver the corner kick.
2' A lofted cross from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
Davide Di Marco is introduced as the referee for today's match.
